method.unitDefinitions: body=absolute final confirmation close-open; confirmation-range=its high-low including wicks; pattern-range=entire engulfing pattern high-low; risk=distance from original reference to original SL. All percentage entries are measured from original reference, BUY subtracts and SELL adds.
method.search: 384 geometries × 4 risk splits = 1536 variants. First 0/2.5/5/10/15/20%, second 5/10/15/20/25/35/50% and greater than first. Four units. Entry deadlines 30/75/150 minutes. First risk share 30/50/60/80%, remainder second. Original SL/TP and fixed $4 total setup risk unchanged.
method.selection: Maximize training net R among candidates with >=85% both-filled setups, win rate >= old training win rate, positive pessimistic training R bound, and >=70% old resolved count. Material threshold=at least 20% more training profit than old. Choices frozen at October 1 and November 1 and evaluated on the next month.
method.chronology: Training outcomes are truncated at each boundary; only closed candles available by that boundary are used. Open trades are not carried between monthly folds. This expanding-window strategy comparison reuses previously reviewed historical data; it is not a pristine unseen test.
method.dollarModel: Ideal fractional lots, fixed $4 total setup risk with specified allocation, no compounding. Changing allocation never increases total risk. Excludes fees, spread, slippage, margin, daily-loss restrictions, half-risk overlap adjustments and maximum-open-trade limits. Entire uncertain/open setups excluded from main P&L; pessimistic and optimistic bounds also retained.
method.brokerSizing: Separate sensitivity: current Exness XAUUSDm contract 100 oz, .01-lot minimum and step, rounded down; if split cannot fit, skip first and retry second with full $4 budget. It is sizing sensitivity, not executable broker P&L.
method.fillModel: Existing exhaustive OHLC ordering helper. A fill needs agreement across possible paths; fills and exits have separate uncertainty. Original TP/SL touch retires unfilled orders even before entry deadline. Missing history stays uncertain.
method.counting: Both-fill percentage divides by all archived qualifying setups, including invalid/missing-data setups. TP/SL percentages divide by resolved setups only. 1 gold pip=.10 price units, pips are unweighted totals of filled legs in fully resolved setups.
method.limitations: Repeated selection across many variants increases overfitting. Some variants can alter which ambiguous setups are excluded, so gross profit alone can mislead. One instrument and a short, SELL-heavy sample. No live source, account settings, or positions changed.

dailyResampling.method: Paired resampling by confirmation UTC calendar day; Python random seed 20261120; 10,000 replicates. Uses published ideal known-outcome P&L. Does not resolve OHLC uncertainty or adjust for selecting among 1,536 variants. Not independent significance evidence.
